chunks: And with this chain of transmission, he said:
The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Do not leave the crucified one after three days; rather, he should be taken down and then buried.”
ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله command about leaving a crucified person after three days?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal directive from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله regarding the treatment of a crucified body. It establishes that such a person is not to remain suspended beyond three days, but must then be taken down and buried.
